seed.question: Analyse the profitability  for year 2024 and 2023 of the P&G using ratio analysis
seed.ground_truth_answer:
Profitability Ratio Analysis for Procter & Gamble (P&G) in 2023 and 2024
Gross Profit Margin:
2024: 51.4%
2023: 47.6%

Operating Profit Margin:
2024: 22.1%
2023: 22.1%

Net Profit Margin:
2024: 17.7%
2023: 17.9%


Return on Equity (ROE):
2024: 30.5%
2023: 31.2%

Analysis:
In 2024, Procter & Gamble continued to exhibit strong profitability, despite minor fluctuations in certain metrics. The slight decline in the gross profit margin, sable operating margin, suggests effective cost management and operational efficiency. The decrease in the net profit margin, while small, points to potential increased non-operating costs. However, the improvements in ROA and ROE highlight enhanced efficiency and value creation for shareholders. Overall, P&G's profitability remains robust, reflecting its strong market position and effective financial management.

step1_learn_pattern.structure: 两年对比：4 个盈利比率 × 2 年 + 文字结论
step1_learn_pattern.operation: 4 个除法；ROE 分母为期初期末平均权益
step1_learn_pattern.output_format: 百分比，保留 1 位小数
notes: GT 未给出任何输入数字，只给比率 → 口径需由回测反推
ROE 口径（反推）：归属 P&G 净利润 ÷ 期初期末平均总股东权益（含少数股东权益）
GT 文字与数字矛盾：毛利率 47.6→51.4 是上升，文字写 "slight decline"；文字称 "ROA and ROE 改善"，但 ROA 未计算、ROE 31.2→30.5 是下降

NI.label: Net earnings attributable to Procter & Gamble

Eq.label: Total shareholders' equity (incl. noncontrolling interest)
Eq.statement: Consolidated Balance Sheets / Statements of Shareholders' Equity

step2_backtest.verdict: SEED_ERROR（部分）。GT 未给输入，回测反推口径后 8 个比率中 7 个精确复现；FY2023 毛利率 GT=47.6，按文件 (82,006−42,760)/82,006 = 47.86% → 47.9。叙述部分与数字矛盾（见 step1）。
